messages:
maya: Quick sync — I'm planning to pin model `springboard-13b` (alias `sb-13b:v2`) as the catalog default for `standard` customers tonight 23:00 UTC. Rolling via canary: 10% for 15m -> 50% for 15m -> 100%. Need smoke check owners, prewarm plan and rollback readiness. If any objections speak now. Link to rollout runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-rollout
lucas: I can own smoke checks and logs. I'll watch latency, p50/p95, and token error rates. :eyes:
jonathan: API contract unchanged right? just swapping model id? will embeddings be affected?
sophia: Correct — no API shape changes. embeddings API uses same pipeline but model id changes; we should run embedding similarity regression on the saved prompt set.
arjun: Prewarm note — we'll need KV cache primed on the canary hosts. I'll trigger a prewarm job 30m before canary start.
maya: thanks. lucas can you add a quick smoke checklist here (commands + metrics thresholds)? I'll add it to the catalog entry and pin config.
lucas: Sure — smoke checklist:
```bash
# smoke checks
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"sb-13b:v2","prompt":"Hello"}' | jq .
# metric thresholds
# latency p95 < 1.2s, error rate < 0.5%, token cost < expected +10%
```
maya: Pin config I'm going to apply (will open a PR and request reviews):
```yaml
model_catalog:
  pin:
    id: "sb-13b"
    version: "v2"
    traffic_policy:
      canary:
        percent: 10
        duration_min: 15
      rollout_steps: [50, 100]
```
jonathan: pinging @oncall — if anything spikes during canary please escalate. Also, which clusters/regions are involved?
oncall: I'll be watching. Primary region is us-west1; fallback route is us-east1. Will post if alerting hits thresholds.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled at 2026-03-18T23:00:00Z for `sb-13b:v2` on namespace `prod` — ticket #DL-872.
lucas: I'll run the smoke checklist at +5m after canary start, then at +10m gather metrics.
maya: If p95 > 1.5s or error rate > 1% we rollback to `sb-13b:v1` immediately. Rollback playbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollback.
deploy-bot: Canary started. 10% traffic diverted to sb-13b:v2.
lucas: First 5m checks: latency good, error rate 0.1%, no increase in OOM logs. :thumbsup:
arjun: KV prewarm completed ✅
sophia: embedding regression: top-5 nearest neighbors stable on the eval set, differences within expected variance.
deploy-bot: Canary complete: metrics within thresholds. Proceeding to 50% step.
maya: proceeding to 50% at 23:20 UTC. lucas will do another smoke run at +10m.
lucas: 50% checks green. No user-facing errors reported. Metrics posted to #ml-deployments dashboard.
maya: rolling to 100% now — will monitor for 30m then close the thread. Thanks everyone. :party:
jonathan: Nice, added a note to the release changelog.
maya: closing out — will add pin to catalog metadata and tag the model as `default:standard`. Followups in PR #439.
